issue.mint_text: Royal Thai Mint · not letter-marked on shown sides

C162.notes: SER AS-TH-001. Both sides photo’d. Obverse Rama IX (Bhumibol Adulyadej) left-facing with glasses · Thai legend. Reverse Wat Phra Kaew (Temple of the Emerald Buddha) · ประเทศไทย · พ.ศ. ๒๕๔๙ (BE 2549 = 2006 CE) · ๑ บาท. User: Both sides of 1 coin. Workhorse baht — Bangkok skytrain / market / street-food change in the late Rama IX years. Country #25 — first Thailand. Thailand flips now 1.
C162.story: A 2006 1 baht from Thailand. The obverse shows Rama IX (Bhumibol Adulyadej) left-facing with glasses; the reverse shows Wat Phra Kaew; ประเทศไทย, พ.ศ. ๒๕๔๙, ๑ บาท. Struck in CuNi (nickel-clad steel common for type).
